title: Linguistically Differentiating Acts and Recalls of Racial Microaggressions on Social Media

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying acts versus recalls of racial microaggressions against Black individuals using fine-tuned language models (BERT, RoBERTa, XLNet), and applying Integrated Gradients alongside qualitative discourse analysis to identify predictive thematic tokens and linguistic signatures (e.g., stereotyping, hedging, and absolute terminology).
